ننصرف (form VII)
# نَنْصَرِفُ (nanṣarifu) /nan.sˤa.ri.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْصَرَفَ (inṣarafa)
# نَنْصَرِفَ (nanṣarifa) /nan.sˤa.ri.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْصَرَفَ (inṣarafa)
# نَنْصَرِفْ (nanṣarif) /nan.sˤa.rif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْصَرَفَ (inṣarafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
